verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll SaaS platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question. Its marketing site says Warp can be used from Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP, which implies a first-party MCP server. That is the only evidence: the developer docs never describe an MCP server, endpoint, setup or tool list. missing for 10: documented MCP server endpoint or install instructions, authentication/configuration details for MCP clients, list of exposed tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use Warp from the agents your team already runs. Claude, ChatGPT, and any client that speaks MCP.
